approvers: Owner only, after a site visit and quote
reason: We use the factory film on the frames at no extra cost and it covers most of the programme. About €19/m² for a coating on the glass is a big jump from nothing, and I can't see where it pays back in fewer callbacks.
objection: €19/m² on top of film that costs us nothing, and a 150 m² minimum per job, when I can't yet show the snagging savings. I'd also want to know who pays if the coating damages the glass or won't peel off cleanly.
instead: Keep the factory film on the profiles, plus cheap tape and board protection, and clean or replace damaged glass at handover when it happens.
would_change_my_mind: A reference from a premium block in Malta where it cut glazing claims or snagging delays by more than it cost, a written warranty on glass and frame damage, and a price nearer €8-10/m².
